metrics.ocr: Existing normalized CER/WER scoring; absent archive outputs count as missing, not zero CER.
metrics.tables: Existing row/column aligned exact cell accuracy and exact-grid metrics.
metrics.reading_order: Existing order reference scored independently by layout split; missing validation annotations are reported as a missing gate, not a score.
metrics.resources: Runner-reported preprocessing and batch inference wall time; one-second sampled process-tree RSS, GPU-process memory, and device memory cover inference and retries. This tuning pass is single-repeat and does not replace the three-repeat 200-page performance benchmark.
metrics.paired_comparisons: Candidate minus V0; 95% percentile confidence intervals from 10,000 paired issuer-cluster bootstrap resamples. OCR/table intervals include only paired items with both outputs; missing-output coverage is reported separately.
